def native_check_and_export(controller, references, b2, device, run_id, export_id=None):
 import sys,time,math,json,collections
 from pathlib import Path
 sys.path.insert(0,'results/T-048/scripts')
 from chay import OUT,read,dump,sha
 from kiem import read_run,export_closed_controller
 from cham import WORLDS
 from m1 import xep_hang
 folder=OUT/'runs'/run_id;folder.mkdir();start=time.monotonic();deadline=start+10800
 (folder/'command.json').write_text(dump(dict(controller=controller,references=references,B2=b2,device=device,analysis_source=ANALYSIS_SOURCE))+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 while not (OUT/'runs'/controller/'kiem.json').exists() or not (OUT/'runs'/b2/'kiem.json').exists():
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Kiểm native tới trần chờ')
  time.sleep(10)
 assert read(OUT/'runs'/controller/'kiem.json')['success'] and not read(OUT/'runs'/b2/'kiem.json')['exceptions']
 allocation=read(OUT/'ma-tran.json')['allocation'];hashes={};counts=collections.Counter();inputs={}
 for name in [*references,controller]:
  for child in read(OUT/'runs'/name/'kiem.json')['finished']:
   cmd,meta,pairs=read_run(OUT/'runs'/child);hashes[child]=meta
   for r,d in pairs():
    oid=r['opaque_id'];kind=d['window']
    if allocation[oid]!=device:continue
    t=d['trace'];key=(oid,kind)
    assert r['status'] in ('OK','NO_EVIDENCE') and r['method']=='M1' and r['method_version']=='M1-T046-1' and r['mode']=='a'
    assert r['config_id']==r['variant']==d['config_id'] and d['config_id'] in cmd['configs']
    assert inputs.setdefault(key,t['normalized_input_sha256'])==t['normalized_input_sha256']
    assert len(t['xep'])>=3 and set(r['worlds'])==set(WORLDS)
    for i,w in enumerate(WORLDS):
     rank=t['xep'][i]['ket_qua'];state=t['world_state'][w]
     assert rank['blocks']==r['worlds'][w]['blocks'] and rank['thu_tu']==r['worlds'][w]['thu_tu']
     assert sum(x==1 for x in rank['tang'].values())==state['N1']
     valid=sum(bool(v['cham'].get('hop_le')) and v['don_vi']['thuc_the'] in set(t['U']) for v in state['units']);assert valid==state['valid_units']
     assert xep_hang.verdict(rank['tang'],valid)==state['V0']
     assert all(math.isfinite(x) for block in rank['blocks'] for x in block['key'])
    assert r['blocks']==t['xep'][0]['ket_qua']['blocks'] and r['verdict']==t['world_state']['P']['V0']
    counts.update(records=1,worlds=3)
 if export_id:export_closed_controller(OUT/'runs'/controller,export_id)
 (folder/'kiem.json').write_text(dump(dict(closed=True,counts=counts,windows=len(inputs),hashes=hashes,export=export_id,wall_seconds_including_wait=time.monotonic()-start))+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 return dict(counts)
